summary: Round-1 MAJOR tests/ci/speed-limits.acceptance.test.ts:summary-regex-breaks-with-forced-color is FIXED. In commit a6768ad, runPerfSuites deletes FORCE_COLOR, sets NO_COLOR=1 and strips /\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/g from the combined output. The commit changed only these lines in this test. All five assertions are unchanged: exit code 0 / non-0, the 'speed limits not enforced (CI=true)' marker, 'seven-card evals/s', /Tests\s+2 passed/, /Tests\s+2 failed/, and not.toContain on the marker. So nothing was weakened. Verified sequentially with no other Vitest run active: `FORCE_COLOR=1 npx vitest run tests/ci/speed-limits.acceptance.test.ts` gives 2 passed (it failed 2/2 in round 1). Without FORCE_COLOR: 2 passed. With FORCE_COLOR=1 CI=true: 2 passed. The gate fix-3.json shows npm test, lint and typecheck passing. No new BLOCKER or MAJOR.
